authority: City Horizon simple coaster vehicle runtime atlas
designGoal: smooth classic tycoon-style train articulation on flat curves, slopes and airtime hills without inversions

poseConvention.pitchDegrees: positive nose-up rotation around the car local +X axis
poseConvention.anchor: track rail center under the car

flatCurveAtlas.reason: one 90-degree quarter curve receives five atlas headings including both endpoints; rotating the track through four cardinals exercises all sixteen headings

verticalPoseSupplement.reason: CH_COASTER_TRACK_V1 slope and hill pieces are longitudinal/cardinal; only flat curves need intermediate yaw headings

trainComposition.placement: sample route centerline independently for each car by distance offset
trainComposition.headingSelection: nearest flatCurveAtlas heading from local tangent for flat/curve pieces
trainComposition.pitchSelection: nearest verticalPoseSupplement pitch bin for slope/hill pieces
trainComposition.spriteSelection: flat 16-way atlas for pitch near zero; otherwise cardinal heading plus pitch bin
trainComposition.depthOrdering: sort individual car sprites by projected ground anchor/depth
